samples_reviewed.question_text: A shape slides 5 spaces to the left and 2 spaces down. What type of movement is this?
A shape moves 2 spaces right AND 3 spaces up. How many directions did it slide?
A figure slides 2 spaces left, then 1 more space left, then 4 spaces up. What is the total movement in the two directions?
A circle at grid coordinate (2, 4) slides 5 spaces right and 1 space down. At what grid point will the circle be drawn?
A shape slides 5 spaces to the left and 2 spaces down. What type of movement is this?
A rectangle undergoes a two-direction slide: 4 units right and 2 units up. Does the orientation or shape of the rectangle change?
A circle at grid coordinate (2, 4) slides 5 spaces right and 1 space down. At what grid point will the circle be drawn?
A point moves from (1, 1) to (4, 5). How many units right and how many units up did it slide?
A shape starts at position (5, 5). It undergoes a two-direction slide: 2 spaces left and 3 spaces down. What is the new position?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The describe and draw verbs are only partly served. Several items merely classify the motion, keying two-direction slide (translation) or counting that the shape slid in 2 directions, rather than describing or producing the resulting figure. The nearest thing to drawing is naming the grid point where a circle lands.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Multi-step is written into the competency but reaches exactly one sample, the figure that slides 2 spaces left, then 1 more space left, then 4 spaces up to give 3 spaces left and 4 spaces up. Every other sample is a single two-direction slide, so the accumulating sub-case is barely generated.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Ordered-pair coordinate notation such as (2, 4) and (7, 3) carries four of the nine samples, although the competency itself speaks only of spaces and directions. That notation is a heavier convention than the slide idea requires at Grade 3 Quarter 4.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Two stems recur verbatim within nine samples, the 5-left-and-2-down classification item and the circle at (2, 4) item each appearing twice, and all nine are multiple choice. No sample supplies a figure on a grid to be slid and redrawn.

competency_alignment.rationale: The set does reach past naming into the substance of translation: one item establishes that only position changes and neither orientation nor shape does, and another inverts the task by deriving the slide from a start and end point.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Slides of one to five spaces on a small grid with coordinates in single digits keep every translation countable by hand, which suits the figure-sliding work of this quarter.
